notes.title: UPDATE - VERSION 1.0.0 RELEASED
notes.content:
-----News-----

>General Fixes.
>Maps updated.
>Fixed fisrt login bug for some users.
>Anti cheat updated.
>Added new map: Strip
>Added Nebelwerfer
>Added Double Barrel
>Added Surf Board
>Added Nailed Bat
>Added Alfa 8C and 8Cleaned
>Added Alfa 561
>Graphic improvements
>Performance improvements
>Fixed some texts
>Fixed new player's infinite loading for some people
>Added russian translations: Thanks to RAM1S

-----1.0.0: What's going on?-----

It was scheduled a year ago, and all the features that should have made up the game, today there are.
For this reason it seems acceptable to indicate this game as "version 1.0.0"
Keep in mind that updates with new features will continue to be released.
The main difference lies in the fact that marking the game as a "complete game" should increase the number of players, and therefore make the game more enjoyable - which is the essential part of every game.

So new updates will be released, albeit more slowly.
Many things will have to be improved and arranged, but as a university student, know that I will not be able to work miracles.
I will try to give the best of me anyway.

Thank you all.
